title: Tityus
summary: Raleigh names Tityus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Tityus, whom Apollo slew for seeking to force Latona; sonne of Elara the Daughter of Orchomenus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. II, sig. 263a
